platformRegions.intro: The regions the platform runs nodes in. Each has an address its nodes answer at, which can be a reference such as ${env:NAME}, kept exactly as entered. Each organization chooses which of these regions it uses.
platformRegions.restartNote: Changes to the platform's regions take effect when the nodes restart.
platformRegions.restartPending: Saved. The nodes keep running on the previous regions until they restart.
platformRegions.idHelp: A short lowercase name, such as eu or us. A node is started in one region.
platformRegions.addressHelp: Where the region's nodes answer, or a reference such as ${env:NAME}. Kept exactly as entered.
platformRegions.deleteConsequence: Region {{id}} is removed from the platform when the nodes restart. An organization that uses it can no longer start there.
